items.html: And there is a Kav called Kav HaCharuvin [the measure of carobs], which was the death and destruction of the aforementioned kings; and it is not as pure as the first, because it is from the phase of the posteriors, in which the Klipot have their hold, which caused the destruction of the kings, as will be written, God willing. And they are the phase of the four posteriors that there are in the four names AB, SAG, MA, BON, which are the sixth degree that there is in each one of them, as above, for in the posteriors the fillings of each one of them have twenty-six letters of filling, except for the name BON, whose filling of its posteriors has only twenty-four letters; the sum of all their letters is one hundred and two.
